scenario: [LGRA.2.9.6.2] — a `let` bound to a sync-impure builtin (`now()` / `cached()`) is interpolable by name, exactly like a pure let: interpolation formats the bound VALUE (bound-once at the bind, LGRA.9.8.4), not a slot path, so it introduces no new nondeterminism. Pin: `let n = now()` then `log info "value is {n}"` compiles clean. Inline `{now()}` as an expression stays barred (LGRA.2.9.6.2_operator_body_rejects).
